NIBSDescription: 10 Hz tACS over left sensorimotor cortex for 20 min, delivered through a 4x1 high-definition ring montage. Centre electrode over C3 at 1 mA amplitude; four return electrodes (FC3, C1, C5, CP3) at -0.25 mA each. Delivered offline.

ElectrodeSize.Description: radius of the Ag/AgCl HD electrode

ElementSet.ElectrodePreparation: Skin cleaned with alcohol; conductive gel applied through the HD holder.

nibs_event_id.Description: Identifier of a stimulation parameter set. Referenced from *_events.tsv. MUST be unique within the file.

stimulator_id.Description: Device that generates the waveform. Links to StimulatorSet.StimulatorID.

nibs_element_id.Description: Electrodes in the montage, in order. Links to ElementSet.ElementID.

stimulus_shape.Description: Waveform shape of the base stimulus.

stimulus_intensity.Description: Delivered current amplitude per electrode, in the same order as nibs_element_id. For tES the values sum to 0.

stimulus_duration.Description: Total duration of the tACS block.

starting_phase.Description: Phase of the sinusoid at onset.

intensity_reference.Description: Anchor used to set the intensity. 'absolute' means the value is specified directly. Closed vocabulary (rMT, aMT, 1mV, e-field, absolute).

intensity_scaling.Description: Multiplier applied to the reference value, or 'absolute' for a directly specified value.
